title: Affine Sign Functions Are Sign-Valued
statement: For every natural number $n$, every sign $\\sigma\\in\\{−1,1\\}$, and every vector $\\gamma\\in\\mathbb F_2^n$, the function on $\\mathbb F_2^n$ given by $x\\mapsto\\sigma(-1)^{\\sum_{j=1}^n\\gamma_jx_j}$ takes only values of absolute value $1$.
